text:
emma: Morning — quick sync on launch posts + credit-led webinar funnel. Goal: 2% activation uplift by week 2. TL;DR: run a 3-arm microexperiment (no-credit vs $15 vs $35) + two prompt-template variants for onboarding. Thoughts?
liam: love the econ spread. can we do stratified by org-size? small startups vs mid-market?
jasper: drafting copy for three posts — short, narrative, and technical. will share snippets in a sec. :pencil2: 
noah: baseline conversion from free-credits campaigns is 5.1% (last 90d). our target is reasonable but we'll need decent traffic. sending cohort calc: `n_per_arm = 1200` to detect 1.5pp lift with 80% power.
arya: inbound routing note — route attendees who claim credits to growth-sales for follow-up if MRR > $2500. Otherwise standard PLG drip. Also add tag `webinar_credit_claim`.
jasper: Copy idea A (short): "Ship faster with Redwood — join our free workshop and get $15 to run your first 10k tokens." Copy B (narrative): "How one product manager cut inference cost 3x — workshop + credits." Copy C (technical): "Live demo: batching, caching & quantization — $35 lab credit for attendees."
liam: for post timing: phase 1 teaser (Mon), phase 2 registration push (Wed), phase 3 last call (Fri). syndicate to HN, Product Hunt, and partner newsletter.
emma: webinar landing needs two CTA flows: claim+onboard (credit-driven) and RSVP-only (no-credit). track both with separate UTMs.
analytics-bot: Query complete — pulled weekly cohort numbers. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/webinar-credit-experiments (will update after deploy).
noah: PRD for experiment: `cohort_id=launch_submarine_0427`, arms=[0,15,35], prompt_variants=[starter,pro], metric=activation_7d. I'll add to shared sheet.
jasper: sharing draft assets here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/submarine-launch-assets — screenshots + GIFs. preference for narrative hero image.
arya: routing checklist: 1) claim event -> create lead with tag 2) if MRR>2500 assign to growth-sales 3) if trial starts within 48h send high-touch email.
emma: one more ask — include an explicit experiment note in the launch post: "limited credits for attendees" to avoid overpromising. small ops lift but safer. :thumbsup:
liam: can ops schedule feature-flag rollout for credit amounts? we should be able to flip amounts without landing changes.
jasper: ack, I'll make copy flexible variables: `{{credit_amount}}` in templates.
noah: last ask — add a small benchmark section in the webinar: show token-cost before/after caching so we have narrative data for follow-up posts.
emma: perfect. jasper + noah + arya — please iterate the doc by EOD. i'll prep the launch calendar. Thanks! :rocket:
